prose:
A film project page contains brief production notes about replacing a song take and reshooting motion synchronized to the voice while retaining a few shots. The feed presents the project as AI-created.

The retrieved text is short and the film itself was not viewed. It cannot support an assessment of visual quality, originality or the exact division of human and model authorship.
highlights: Readable evidence is limited to production notes
Notes describe a revised song take
Authorship and quality were not independently assessed
